### What You Should Know about Huldah in the Bible
Author: Jason Soroski
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/what-you-should-know-about-huldah-in-the-bible.html
Passage: 2 Kings 22:14-20
Points:
- When King Josiah realized Judah had neglected God's law, his leaders sought guidance from Huldah the prophetess.
- Huldah boldly confirmed that judgment was coming upon Judah due to generations of unfaithfulness and idolatry.
- God spared Josiah from witnessing this disaster because he responded with humility, grief, and a tender heart.
- The narrative shows that God freely uses anyone He chooses to convey His message of truth.
- Believers are encouraged to speak God's word with courage and work together to honor Him.
